language.title: Language
language.description: Desktop-wide UI language. Applies instantly — no restart needed.
language.updateFailed: Could not save the language preference

telemetry.title: Pipeline Telemetry
telemetry.description: Capture token usage, phase durations, and subagent activity for diagnostic export. On by default.
telemetry.toggleDescription: When on, OTEL data from pipeline jobs is captured locally. Use the <mono>Export diagnostic</mono> button on any job card to download.

prePrompt.title: Rail Pre-prompt
prePrompt.description: Extra project-specific instructions appended to implement rail jobs after the ticket context and before execution.
prePrompt.label: Pre-prompt
prePrompt.placeholder: Example: Prefer incremental changes, keep migrations backward compatible, and add tests for every rail change.
prePrompt.helper: Use this for stable project guidance that should accompany every rail implementation run.

freestylePrePrompt.title: Freestyle pre-prompt
freestylePrePrompt.description: Instruction sent to the selected provider in Freestyle. Freestyle skips the OpenSpec pipeline — it hands the provider this pre-prompt plus the spec text and lets it implement autonomously. Leave blank to use the built-in default.
freestylePrePrompt.label: Freestyle pre-prompt
freestylePrePrompt.placeholder: Leave blank to use the default Freestyle instruction.
freestylePrePrompt.helper: The spec text is appended automatically after this pre-prompt. Empty = default.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Set a daily spend cap for this project. The queue auto-pauses when the limit is hit.
budget.dailyHelper: Leave blank to disable. Spend is calculated over the last 24 hours.
budget.perJobHelper: Alert when a single job in this project exceeds this amount.
budget.invalidNumber: Enter a positive number or leave blank to disable

desktop.title: Desktop Settings
desktop.description: Manage registered projects and view Desktop information.
desktop.techUrlDescription: Base URL for the specrails-tech API (default: http://localhost:3000)
desktop.dailyBudgetHelper: Global daily spend limit across all projects. Queues auto-pause when exceeded.
desktop.perJobHelper: Alert when a single job exceeds this amount. Leave blank to disable.
desktop.dailyBudgetSaveFailed: Failed to save Desktop daily budget
desktop.platformTourDescription: Replay the welcome wizard to review key features.

notifications.heading: OS Notifications
notifications.description: Show native desktop notifications when jobs complete or fail. Notifications only appear when the tab is not focused.

webhooks.heading: Outbound Webhooks
webhooks.description: Notify external tools (Slack, Zapier, CI/CD) on Desktop events. Requests are signed via X-Specrails-Signature when a secret is set.

terminal.title: Terminal panel
terminal.desktopDescription: Desktop-wide defaults applied to every project unless a per-project override is set.
terminal.projectDescription: Per-project overrides for the terminal panel. Leave a field unchanged to inherit the Desktop default.
terminal.quickScript: Quick script (pasted into active terminal — Enter manually)

codeSection.heading: Code section
codeSection.budgetHelper: Cap on `surface=file-summary` spend per calendar month. User-initiated regenerations can override.

taglines.dracula: The original — dark purple-tinted with vivid neon accents
taglines.aurora-light: Premium light — Linear-inspired indigo on warm off-white
taglines.obsidian-dark: Premium dark — near-black blue-tinted with electric accents
taglines.specrails: Brand theme — deep navy-indigo with saturated cyan accents
taglines.code-rain: Phosphor terminal — soft mint on green-tinted near-black
taglines.galaxy: Deep-space blue with a glowing blade trail

mobile.heading: Mobile companion
mobile.description: Control Specrails from the SpecRails Companion app on your phone, 100% over your local network. Off by default.
mobile.resetConfirm: Reset the mobile identity? Every paired device will be revoked and must pair again.
mobile.windowsFirewall: Windows Firewall will ask to allow the SpecRails server on first enable — choose “Allow on private networks”.

pairWeb.title: Pair web companion
pairWeb.description: Open specrails.dev/companion-app on your phone, then scan this code with it.
pairWeb.showThenScan: After your phone scans this, tap “Scan phone's code” and point the camera at your phone.
pairWeb.scanning: Point the camera at the code on your phone…
pairWeb.notAnswer: That QR isn't a pairing answer.
pairWeb.answerRejected: The desktop rejected that code. Generate a fresh one and retry.

coreUpdate.heading: Specrails Core
coreUpdate.affectsAll: Applies to all projects — no restart needed.
coreUpdate.unavailable: Core updates aren't available in this build.
coreUpdate.toastUpToDate: Specrails Core is up to date
coreUpdate.loadFailed: Could not refresh Core status. Retry
coreUpdate.stableFallback: specrails-core has no stable release yet, so Core follows Latest for now.

updateChannel.heading: Update channel
updateChannel.scope: Applies to Specrails Desktop and the specrails-core framework.
updateChannel.saveFailed: Could not change the update channel: {{message}}

latest.label: Latest
latest.description: Every release as soon as it ships. Newest features and fixes first.

stable.label: Stable
stable.description: Only releases promoted after at least a week on Latest with green CI. Core follows its stable tag.

appUpdate.heading: Specrails Desktop
appUpdate.autoHint: Checks automatically at launch and every 6 hours.
appUpdate.unavailable: App updates are only available in the desktop app.
appUpdate.toastUpToDate: Specrails Desktop is up to date
appUpdate.stableUnavailable: No release has been promoted to the Stable channel yet. Switch to Latest or try again later.

projectDialog.title: {{name}} — Settings
projectDialog.description: Project-level configuration: prompts, branch, environment, budget, telemetry and terminal.

integrationBranch.title: Integration branch
integrationBranch.description: The branch parallel rails branch from and target their draft PRs at. Leave empty to auto-resolve to the repository's default branch.
integrationBranch.saveFailed: Could not save the integration branch

worktreeEnv.title: Worktree environment
worktreeEnv.description: Choose environment variable names this project passes to rail jobs and isolated loop worktrees. Only names are saved; values are read when a run starts, with login-shell recovery when the desktop process is missing them.
worktreeEnv.label: Environment variable
worktreeEnv.helper: Press Enter or Add. You can paste several names separated by commas or spaces.
worktreeEnv.saveFailed: Could not save the worktree environment
worktreeEnv.invalidName: {{name}} is not a valid environment variable name
worktreeEnv.noValues: Add only variable names here, not KEY=value secrets.

hint.inherited: Available in the environment Specrails started with.
hint.recovered: Recovered from {{shell}}. Runs receive it automatically; the value is never shown.
hint.notDefined: {{shell}} does not export {{name}}. Add an export for it to your shell profile, then check again.
hint.notDefinedInherited: {{name}} is not set in the environment Specrails started with. Set it there and restart Specrails.
hint.probeTimeout: {{shell}} took longer than {{seconds}} s to start. Speed up the profile or raise SPECRAILS_LOGIN_SHELL_TIMEOUT_MS, then check again.
hint.probeFailed: Specrails could not read {{shell}}. Fix the profile or launch Specrails from a terminal, then check again.
hint.pending: Specrails is reading your login shell.

worktreeEnv.statusUnavailable: Could not read the environment status.

agentEnv.title: Agent environment
agentEnv.description: Choose which environment variables this project's agents receive: rail jobs, loops, missions, chats and spec helpers.

inherit.label: Inherit (default)
inherit.description: Agents receive the full environment Specrails started with, plus the names above. Same behavior as before.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Agents receive only an allowlist (PATH, HOME, locale, temp, terminal, proxy and certificates), Specrails' own variables, the selected provider's sign-in variables and the names above. Everything else, such as cloud or database credentials, is withheld.

saved.minimal: Agents now receive the minimal environment

agentEnv.saveFailed: Could not save the agent environment
agentEnv.namesHelp: Only names are shown; values are never displayed. Changes apply to agents started afterwards; open mission sessions keep their environment until they restart. If a tool needs another variable, add its name above.
agentEnv.statusUnavailable: Could not read the list of variables.

effects.heading: Effects
effects.description: Visual flourishes across the app. Each one can be switched off here.

thinkingHalo.label: Thinking halo on the agent composer
thinkingHalo.description: While the agent is thinking or writing, the Builder's orbiting ring glows around the composer — it fades in when a turn starts and fades out when the reply settles.

effects.reducedMotion: Follows your system's reduced-motion setting: the ring stays as a static glow.

subagents.title: Sub-agents
subagents.explainParallel: Sub-agents let an agent hand work to helpers that run in parallel and keep going after its reply, reporting back when they finish.
subagents.explainCost: Each sub-agent uses its own tokens, so a single request can cost noticeably more.
subagents.saveFailed: Could not save the sub-agent setting

project.description: Let this project's missions, explore and refinement agents use sub-agents. Off by default.
project.explainScope: Implement pipelines are not affected. Missions with sub-agents running apply a change once those finish.

global.description: Let missions that are not attached to a project use sub-agents. Off by default.
global.toggleLabel: Allow sub-agents in missions without a project
global.explainScope: Each project has its own setting in its project settings. Missions with sub-agents running apply a change once those finish.

runtime.label: Run sub-agents with
runtime.sameHint: Sub-agents use the mission agent's provider, model and effort, launched natively by its own CLI.
runtime.chosenHint: Missions on {{provider}} launch their own sub-agents with this model. On any other provider, Specrails launches them on {{provider}}.
runtime.claudeEffortHint: Claude's own sub-agents ignore effort; it applies when Specrails launches them.
runtime.reset: Sub-agents follow the mission agent again

confirm.title: Run sub-agents with {{provider}}?
confirm.body: In missions on another provider, sub-agents stop being native: Specrails launches each one as its own {{provider}} session instead of the mission's CLI.
confirm.cost: Slower and possibly more expensive: each sub-agent starts cold, without the prompt cache it would share with the mission agent.
confirm.control: More control and flexibility: mix providers, choose model and effort, see each sub-agent's real cost, and keep them working after the mission's reply.
confirm.native: Missions that already run on {{provider}} keep native sub-agents, now with this model and effort.

agentAudit.title: Agent actions audit
agentAudit.description: A per-project log of what agents read, wrote, executed, called over MCP or fetched — exportable as JSONL or CSV from each job and the review packet.
agentAudit.caveat: Older entries are removed at startup and daily. Reads are only as complete as each provider's stream; contents and environment values are never stored.
agentAudit.saveFailed: Could not save the audit retention
agentAudit.invalidDays: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and {{max}}

reviewWip.title: Review limit
reviewWip.description: Cap how many deliveries can wait for your review at once, so new work does not pile up faster than you can decide it.
reviewWip.label: Deliveries waiting for review
reviewWip.help: We suggest {{suggested}}: enough to keep rails busy while you review. Running deliveries, undecided ones and open PRs created by the app count. Changes to an existing delivery are always allowed. Leave it empty for no limit.
reviewWip.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}, or leave it empty for no limit.
reviewWip.saveFailed: Could not save the review limit

anchoring.title: Existing-project anchoring
anchoring.description: Optional behaviours that help runs respect what the project already does. Each one needs a Core that supports it.
anchoring.coreRequired: The installed Core does not support this yet. Update Core to enable it.

jiraPostClarifications.label: Post architect clarifications to Jira
jiraPostClarifications.description: When a run pauses with the architect's questions, or proceeds on assumptions, post them as a comment on the linked Jira issue. A reply there is recorded on the spec as a clarification.
jiraPostClarifications.enabled: Clarifications will be posted to Jira

baselineOnTouch.label: Baseline on touch
baselineOnTouch.description: When a change reaches code no spec describes, first write characterization tests (proven on the unchanged code) and a minimal as-built spec. Adds cost, reported apart.

rules.title: Project rules
rules.description: The checks this project already runs and every written rule, classified as enforced, automatable or human-only. Human-only rules appear in each review packet.
rules.coreRequired: The installed Core does not support the rules inventory. Update Core to run it.
rules.missing: No inventory yet. Run it to list the project's gates and rules.
rules.invalid: The rules file could not be read: {{message}}
rules.gatesHint: Plain gate commands are offered first as verification checks in the agent runtime settings when none are configured.
rules.dropped_one: {{count}} entry did not match the format and was skipped
rules.dropped_other: {{count}} entries did not match the format and were skipped

classification.offline: Rules were inventoried offline and are not classified yet. Re-run the inventory with a configured provider.
classification.unavailable: No provider is configured to classify the rules.

rules.autoRunning: The inventory is running after setup. This list updates when it finishes.

lastRun.setupFailed: The automatic inventory after setup failed ({{date}}).
lastRun.retryHint: Fix the cause shown above, then re-run the inventory.
